entities.summary: Head Not Found is a Norwegian record label, a sublabel of Voices Music & Entertainment, specializing in various heavy metal subgenres. They describe the genres as black, death, doom, thrash, gothic, viking metal and ambient. Their parent label is Voices of Wonder. Head Not Found was founded in 1992 and its offices are in Oslo.
